text.p: BankAmerica Corp said it plans a two-for-one stock split, subject to shareholder approval at its annual meeting on May 22, 1997.
The resolution placed before shareholders will include a proposed increase in the authorized shares of common stock from 700 million shares to 1.4 billion shares.
BankAmerica has split its stock twice before, on March 31, 1972 when it was trading for aboout $76 per share and on August 17, 1976, when it was trading for about $54 per share.
The new split, if approved, would be effective for common shareholders of record on June 2, 1997. Stock certificates for the new shares would be mailed out on or about June 16.
The corporation had approximately 355,267,000 shares of common stock outstanding at December 31, 1996. The stock closed today at $114.625.
